proposals.title: ADR-009 and CanonicalEncoder implementation in packages/core
proposals.why_now: The specification explicitly requires ADR-009 to be written and the CanonicalEncoder implemented before any StateHash can exist (§15 FASE-1 acceptance, first bullet). TASK-0003 was created for this in CYCLE-000032 but has not been accepted after 11 subsequent cycles. Without the encoder, INV-22 cannot be tested, StateHash cannot be produced, and the replay CLI cannot compare run outputs. Every other FASE-1 deliverable that produces or compares state hashes is gated on this single deliverable. No DEFINIR dependency blocks the encoder: its format is fully specified in ADR-009 (UTF-8 byte key ordering, bigint as signed decimal ASCII, safe-integer distinct marker, explicit rejection of undefined/NaN/Infinity/-0, ordered vs unordered collections, encodingVersion participation).

proposals.title: Electron secure scaffolding, simulation worker, and minimal installer CI pipeline
proposals.why_now: Section 14.6 contains a locked sequencing requirement: the installer must exist in FASE-1 in minimal form, not at the end, and the spec explicitly warns that deferring Electron bootstrap causes ABI and native-module problems to surface too late to fix architecture. INV-29 (contextIsolation active, nodeIntegration off, sandbox active) is a FASE-1 acceptance criterion. The simulation worker separation from the renderer thread is a locked architectural requirement. This work has no dependency on packages/core and can proceed in parallel with IDEA-001, making it the highest-value independent track available right now.

proposals.title: Branded numeric types, ADR-002 hash function, and positional rand() in packages/core
proposals.why_now: After CanonicalEncoder is implemented, the next unblocking step for all world and domain work is the branded numeric primitives (Money, Quantity, Price, Rate as bigint; Tick as safe integer) and the positional rand() function. The branded types require no DEFINIR resolution — their representation is fully locked in ADR-003. The rand() function requires ADR-002 to specify the hash algorithm bit-by-bit before implementation; the spec recommends SplitMix64 over FNV-1a, so the ADR has a concrete starting point. Without these, packages/world cannot generate prices and packages/domain cannot express monetary values, making both packages impossible to implement correctly.

proposals.title: ADR-004 rounding enforcement, division helpers, and packages/domain ledger foundation
proposals.why_now: The spec requires every division to declare its rounding mode, and ADR-004 defines the enforcement mechanism as DEFINIR. Without this ADR, domain arithmetic cannot be written in a way that satisfies the compile-time or lint-time enforcement the spec mandates. The double-entry ledger (§6) and spot market order execution are FASE-1 requirements; they depend on branded types (IDEA-003) being in place and on the rounding enforcement mechanism being resolved. INV-04 through INV-07 (transaction balance closure, BRL conservation, asset conservation, rounding residue) cannot be tested without a working ledger.

proposals.why_now: FASE-1 requires a price generator covering at least two assets (ORB and NEXA) with trendLayer and idiosyncraticNoise. INV-02 — price(asset, t) queried directly equals price arrived at tick-by-tick — is described by the spec as the most important test in the project. The octave count, periods, and amplitudes are DEFINIR items requiring an ADR before any numbers are embedded. Transcendental functions (log, exp) are prohibited in pure packages; an ADR must document the fixed-point or lookup-table approach. This work becomes unblocked as soon as IDEA-003 delivers rand() and branded types.

warnings: TASK-0003 (CanonicalEncoder) was created in CYCLE-000032 and has not produced a submitted candidate or accepted result across 11 consecutive benchmark cycles. This pattern suggests the implementation agent is not successfully delivering on this task. The orchestrator should consider whether the task scope, acceptance criteria, or implementation guidance needs adjustment to unblock progress.

The hash function for ADR-002 is DEFINIR. rand() must not be implemented before the algorithm is specified bit-by-bit in an ADR. Implementing RNG before this ADR embeds an unregistered number with determinism effect, which violates §19 and §16 item 7.

ADR-004 rounding-mode enforcement mechanism is DEFINIR. Domain arithmetic cannot be written until the technical enforcement approach is specified; without it the invariant exists in name only and cannot satisfy compile-time or lint-time requirements.

The transcendental-function prohibition in §13 combined with the price generator's need for logarithmic and exponential operations means an ADR documenting the fixed-point or lookup-table approach must precede packages/world implementation. This should be specified before any world price code is written.

tools/bench calibration ratios must be frozen during FASE-1 (§18 baseline protocol) but cannot be frozen until packages/core and packages/world exist. This is a sequential dependency that must not be deferred past FASE-1 acceptance.

The Electron installer requirement (§14.6) is a locked sequencing constraint: it must exist in FASE-1 in minimal form. It is currently unaddressed and has no code blocker — it can be started immediately and in parallel with core work.
